translations.web: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
translations.bsb: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
translations.kjv: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
translations.asv: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
